scope: Only these 84 instances individually reviewed; other mechanically admitted rows need curation before Stream use.

capabilities.capability_rule: One upstream skill; calculate mass divided by squared height, converting centimetres to metres. Assign only instances whose sole annotation is medcalcbench_004.
One upstream skill; calculate the conventional resting MAP estimate from systolic and diastolic pressure. Assign only sole annotation medcalcbench_009.
One upstream skill; apply the standard albumin correction with normal albumin explicitly fixed at 4 g/dL. Assign only sole annotation medcalcbench_035.
One upstream skill; instantiate a conditional and affirm its antecedent. Negative questions ask whether the opposite consequent follows. Assign only sole annotation logicbench_000.
One upstream skill; deny a consequent to infer the negated antecedent. Assign only sole annotation logicbench_001; exclude contradictory stories or probabilistic conditionals.

One upstream skill; eliminate a false disjunct from an inclusive disjunction, including double negation. Assign only sole annotation logicbench_002; exclude existential-to-individual substitutions and affirming-a-disjunct errors.

Exactly first skill theoremqa_292. Evaluate a definite integral by antiderivatives, symmetry, or integrating a stated rate; exclude rows requiring unrelated limit theory or missing geometry assumptions.

Exactly first skill theoremqa_291. Count choices or position allocations with binomial coefficients, including constrained subsets and coefficients of a binomial power. No grouping by question keywords or secondary skills.

capabilities.capability_name: Limits of sequences and partial sums
capabilities.capability_rule: Exactly first skill theoremqa_196. Determine limits from asymptotic equivalence, monotonicity, weighted averaging, or partial-sum limits. Every row requires a limit argument; finite trivia and the malformed cosine row are excluded.

Exactly first skill champ_010. Use congruence classes to constrain prime tuples, eliminate integer solutions, prove divisibility, or evaluate powers. Secondary skills are retained as labels but never determine assignment.

Exactly first skill champ_016. Translate a counting or averaging question into binomial choices, stars and bars, or binomial identities. Prefer different structures rather than repeated increasing-digit variants.

capabilities.capability_name: Counting by disjoint cases and state recurrences
capabilities.capability_rule: Exactly first skill champ_012. Partition configurations by the last symbol, boundary tile, or boundary occupancy, then add counts using a finite-state recurrence. This is a focused algorithmic use of the upstream rule of sum, not all additive formulas.
